Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Bend hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 15 Bend hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 3, Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 3, Super.com at 2, Bunk+Brew Historic Lucas House - Hostel at 1, momondo.com at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. Taxes and fees at Bend hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($12 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at WorldMark Bend - Seventh Mountain Resort to 12% at Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Bend near Pilot Butte. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
